# Sanjeevv Kkumar Dass

> Sanjeevv Kkumar Dass is a creator of smart digital tools and a content creator. Simple digital tools for entrepreneurs, professionals, creators & students. Save time, organize work and protect your data with easy-to-use apps.

## Digital tools (sold on Payhip)

Full store: [Sanjeevv Kkumar Dass | Digital Productivity Tools & Apps](https://payhip.com/u1757007407332758617765)

- [PixelFlow Pro](https://payhip.com/b/JuTpC): Offline bulk image resizer & optimizer (Browser app · offline). Resize, compress and ZIP hundreds of images right in your browser. Features: Works offline, with no uploads or installs; Exact size or resize by percentage, with quality control and preview; Download the whole batch as one ZIP file; Single HTML file. Made for: E-commerce sellers, creators, designers, freelancers and small agencies.
- [CoinKeeper](https://payhip.com/b/kFY6P): Expense tracker without bank linking (Browser app · HTML). Track income and expenses and always know your monthly balance. Features: Budgets and recurring bills; Spending charts; No bank linking and no ads; One-time payment. Made for: Salaried people, freelancers, students, side hustlers and families.
- [SecurePass](https://payhip.com/b/VXnq9): Offline password generator (Browser app · offline). Strong passwords generated on your own device, with no cloud and no tracking. Features: Real-time strength meter; Custom length and character sets; Copy to clipboard in one click; Local AES-256 encryption. Made for: Professionals, business owners and students.
- [SenderPro](https://payhip.com/b/y9urE): Bulk personalized SMS sender (Single HTML file). Send bulk personalized SMS from your own device. Features: Your contact lists stay private; One-time purchase with lifetime access; Works on Windows, macOS, Android and iOS. Made for: Small businesses, retailers, agencies, schools, clinics and marketers.
- [WA Bulk Messenger](https://payhip.com/b/xycf0): Bulk WhatsApp messages from CSV (Single HTML file). Send personalized bulk WhatsApp messages from an uploaded CSV. Features: Personalize with {Name}, {Phone} and custom tags; Dashboard with ready-made templates for sales, payments and offers; Lifetime updates and support. Made for: Shop owners, coaches, freelancers and marketers.
- [Cash Tally Pro v22.0](https://payhip.com/b/xmBAs): Offline cash counting & management app (Browser app · offline). Count and manage cash with real-time totals. Features: Indian rupee denominations, from ₹2000 notes to 50 paise coins; Session locks and validation; CSV import and export; One-time payment. Made for: Retailers, petrol pumps, banks, pharmacies, wholesalers and hospitality businesses.
- [PDFy Studio](https://payhip.com/b/Nrjd2): Offline image to PDF converter (Browser app · offline). Combine many images into one PDF, right in your browser. Features: Drag and drop your images; Zero uploads: files stay on your device; Single HTML file. Made for: Professionals bundling scans, receipts and reports.
- [PDFMagic](https://payhip.com/b/wTLyk): Offline PDF merge, split & annotate tool (Browser app · offline). Privacy-first PDF editing in your browser, with no uploads. Features: Merge and split PDFs; Highlight, comment and annotate; Single HTML file. Made for: Students and professionals.
- [ProfitPulse](https://payhip.com/b/Y3t41): E-commerce profit calculator & inventory tracker (Offline · no login). Revenue, costs and profit per product, with no login. Features: Revenue, COGS, net and after-tax profit, and ROI per product; VAT and income-tax estimate; SKU inventory with automatic deduction, low-stock alerts and a restock log; Income statement, top products and JSON backup/restore. Made for: E-commerce and Shopify sellers.
- [ProfitPilot FBA](https://payhip.com/b/vP0LD): Amazon FBA profit spreadsheet (Spreadsheet). See your real profit after fees, ads, returns and storage. Features: Per-product margins; Inventory and reorder timing; PPC spend and expenses; Launch performance and a dashboard. Made for: Amazon FBA sellers.
- [ProfitCraft™](https://payhip.com/b/DxZKz): Etsy profit tracker & business dashboard (Dashboard). Know exactly where every Etsy dollar goes. Features: Sales and order tracker with automatic profit, margin and net-profit calculation; Etsy fee and expense trackers; Listing performance and monthly P&L; Revenue and profit goals, plus a tax section. Made for: Etsy sellers: handmade, digital, print-on-demand, vintage and craft supply.
